items: All You Need for Smart Skincare – This Trial Starter Sampler Mini includes three highly concentrated serums designed to dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and uneven skin tone. The Organicity Discovery Kit features: 3 Types of Hyaluronic Acid 1% Concentrated Face Serum (0.33 Fl Oz) + Niacinamide 20% with 3 Types of Hyaluronic Acid 1% Concentrated Face Serum (0.33 Fl Oz) + Tranexamic Acid 10% with 3 Types of Hyaluronic Acid 1% Medium Viscosity Concentrated Face Serum (0.33 Fl Oz )

items.label: 3 POWER SERUMS. VISIBLE RESULTS – Hyaluronic Acid 1% Serum
items.value: Features ultra-low molecular weight hyaluronic acid for deep skin penetration and long-lasting moisture retention. Niacinamide 20% Serum: High-strength niacinamide helps control excess oil, minimize pores, and visibly brighten the skin. Tranexamic Acid 10% Serum: Targets dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and post-acne discoloration, helping to even out overall skin tone.

items: SUITABLE SKIN TYPES – Ideal for those dealing with enlarged pores, excess oil, uneven tone, and dehydration. Suitable for oily, combination, or dull skin types seeking targeted care and improved balance through high-performance serums.
SCIENCE-DRIVEN PACKAGING – Each serum is packaged in a glass bottle and sealed in oxygen- and light-blocking pouches to maintain freshness and stability until opened.

HOW TO USE – After patch testing, use the high-concentration serum directly. Especially when using retinol directly, apply only a tiny amount, about the size of a grain of rice. Mix 2–3 drops with your serum or cream. Soak a piece of gauze with the diluted serum or cream and apply as a mask, or add it to a modeling mask for enhanced benefits. These serums are suitable for both day and night use. BUT, Retinol is suitable for nighttime use only. Be sure to apply sunscreen during the day.
